findings.title: Node rejects the pod for lack of a resource
findings.cause: node kd-faults-control-plane does not have enough cpu left for the pod (it asks for 1000000, 990 of the node's 4000 are in use), so the kubelet rejects it (OutOfcpu); the pod sets spec.nodeName, so it skipped the scheduler, which would have kept it Pending and said why

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason OutOfcpu
evidence.detail: Pod was rejected: Node didn't have enough resource: cpu, requested: 1000000, used: 990, capacity: 4000

findings.fix: Lower the pod's cpu request to what a node has free, or free that much on the node; leave spec.nodeName unset (use a nodeSelector) so the scheduler places the pod where it fits.
